svg.title: 14. Overhead upper arm stretch — female orange flat color illustration
svg.desc: Raise one arm and bend the elbow. Let that hand rest behind your head. Use the other hand to guide the raised elbow gently backwards.
svg.metadata: Created with built-in image generation using the approved orange female illustration as character and style reference. Converted to curved SVG paths with VTracer. Exercise guide source: https://orthop.washington.edu/patient-care/articles/sports/stretching-exercises-neck-trunk-and-upper-limbs.html
